name: local-fzf
title: Local FZF
description: Search files and directories with fzf
author: nyaran2910

commands.name: index
commands.title: Local FZF
commands.description: Find and open files and directories with fzf

preferences.name: defaultScope
preferences.title: Default Search Location
preferences.description: Location selected when the command opens.

preferences.name: customRoots
preferences.title: Custom Search Locations
preferences.description: List of absolute paths separated by semicolons. For example, ~/Workspace; ~/Documents/Work Files

preferences.name: defaultType
preferences.title: Default Result Type
preferences.description: Kinds of items shown when the command opens.

preferences.name: includeGlobs
preferences.title: Include Globs
preferences.description: Only show paths matching at least one of these semicolon-separated globs. Leave blank to show all candidates.

preferences.name: excludeGlobs
preferences.title: Exclude Globs
preferences.description: Skip paths and folders matching these semicolon-separated globs. Supports names, paths relative to the selected location, and absolute paths.

preferences.name: excludeRegex
preferences.title: Exclude Regular Expression
preferences.description: Optional JavaScript regular expression matched against paths relative to the selected location. Enter the pattern without surrounding slashes.

preferences.name: matchMode
preferences.title: FZF Match Mode
preferences.description: Default matching behavior for terms in the search bar.

preferences.name: fzfPath
preferences.title: FZF Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to fzf. Leave blank to detect the Homebrew, Nix, or PATH installation.
